info.title: ForgePilot API
info.description: Control-plane API for ForgePilot. Every workspace route is scoped to the caller's active workspace; records of other workspaces answer 404.

get.summary: Demo personas for the sign-in screen.
Whether the visitor is signed in and has a workspace (used by onboarding before a workspace exists).

post.summary: Sign in as a demo persona (sets fp_session and fp_ws cookies).

get.summary: Current user, active workspace, role, other workspaces and badge counts.

post.summary: Switch the active workspace.
Create an account (mock GitHub OAuth or email). The user then creates a workspace in onboarding.
Create a workspace for the signed-in user (owner, Free plan with a 14-day Team trial).
Reset all mock data to the seed (demo mode).

get.summary: Which sign-in methods this deployment offers, so the web app shows the right screens.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookies.
End the current session and clear the cookies.
End every session of the signed-in user, on all devices.
Email a password-reset link. Always answers ok, whether or not the address is registered.
Set a new password with a reset token. Signs out every existing session.
Confirm ownership of an email address with the token from the verification email.
Send the verification email again.
Permanently delete the active workspace and everything in it. Owners only; the workspace name must be typed to confirm.
Permanently delete the signed-in account. Refused while the user is the only owner of a workspace.

get.summary: The signed-in user and the workspaces they belong to.

post.summary: Update the signed-in user's profile.

get.summary: What an invitation link is for, shown before the invitee signs up or signs in. ?token=

post.summary: Join the workspace an invitation was issued for. The invitation's email must match the account.

get.summary: Visual comparisons (baseline vs candidate). ?status= &pullRequestId= &runId= &repositoryId=

post.summary: Approve a changed screenshot as the new baseline, or reject it (files a visual-regression bug). Decisions are explicit and audited.

get.summary: Open issues in connected repositories, with what an import would produce. ?repositoryId= &q= &imported=true|false

post.summary: Import GitHub issues as DevPilot tasks: checklists become acceptance criteria, labels set priority. Already-imported issues are skipped.

get.summary: Repositories visible to the GitHub App installation (mock). ?account=

post.summary: Record the GitHub App installation for the workspace (mock).
Connect selected repositories to a project and start indexing (repository intelligence).
Confirm discovered test commands and scan schedule.
Run the first ShipSafe test run or CodeKeeper scan for a repository.

get.summary: Workspace overview: North Star, KPIs, lifecycle funnel, attention list, live sessions, activity, setup checklist.
Projects with health, PR, session and finding counts.

post.summary: Create a project.

get.summary: Project detail: repositories, tasks, PRs, runs and findings.
Connected repositories. ?projectId=
Repository detail: suites, findings, health history, scans, runs, PRs.

post.summary: Start a CodeKeeper scan of the repository.

get.summary: DevPilot command centre: KPIs, board, live sessions, agents.
Tasks. Filters: status, projectId, repositoryId, source, agentId, q.

post.summary: Create a task (optionally launch it). Validates policy, agent and budget.

get.summary: Task detail: sessions, approvals, PR, verification runs, linked bug/finding, lifecycle, activity, policy preview.

post.summary: launch | cancel | retry | archive. Enforces the task state machine, retry cap and budget hard cap.

get.summary: Agent sessions. ?status=
Session detail with workspace, approvals and other attempts.
Structured, secret-redacted session log (poll every ~1.2s while running).
Changed files with hunks for the session's commit.

post.summary: Cancel an active session; the worker is terminated and the workspace cleaned up.

get.summary: Isolated execution workspaces (one per session).
Configured coding-agent runtimes.

post.summary: Update or suspend an agent runtime.

get.summary: Testing dashboard: pass-rate trend, KPIs, failure classes, repositories, recent runs, open bugs.
Test suites. ?repositoryId=

post.summary: Create a test suite.
Update a test suite (enable/disable, required, command, timeout).

get.summary: Test runs. ?repositoryId= &status= &pullRequestId= &trigger=

post.summary: Start a manual test run on a branch.

get.summary: Run detail: environment, commit pins, test plan with reasons, results, evidence, comparison with the previous run, worker log.

post.summary: Rerun with the same commit pin (infra failures rerun free).

get.summary: Bugs from ShipSafe failures. ?status= &severity=
Bug detail with the failing result, evidence, run, PR and fix task.

post.summary: create_fix_task (SS-012: preserves commit, logs and context; capped retries) | resolve | wont_fix | reopen.

get.summary: Pull requests (agent and human) with verification status. ?status= &author=agent|person &repositoryId= &filter=review
PR verification detail: runs, results, bugs, release policy and merge blockers.
Diff for the PR head.

post.summary: Record a human review (mirrors the GitHub review).
Demo only: simulate the GitHub merge webhook. Refused while required checks or review are missing.

get.summary: Repository health: average and trend, per-repository scores, findings breakdown, scans, maintenance PR acceptance, prioritised queue.
Dependency inventory. ?repositoryId= &q= &filter=outdated|vulnerable
Maintenance findings. ?status= &severity= &category= &repositoryId=
Finding detail with advisory evidence, dependency and linked task.

post.summary: create_task (policy-validated DevPilot maintenance task) | suppress (reason + expiry, admins) | unsuppress.

get.summary: Approval centre. ?status=

post.summary: Approve or reject. Bound to the exact action and context; requester can't approve their own request.
Answer an agent's clarification question and resume the session.

get.summary: Analytics (30/90 days): North Star, task success by type, providers (task-mix caveat), PR acceptance, test usefulness, cost per verified task.
Integration catalogue merged with this workspace's connections.

post.summary: Connect (mock OAuth / API key) an integration. Credentials live in the vault; only a reference is stored.
Disconnect and revoke an integration.
Rename the workspace.

get.summary: Members, pending invitations and seats.

post.summary: Invite a member (respects the plan's seat limit).
Revoke a pending invitation.
Change a member's role. Only owners can grant or remove owner; the last owner can't be demoted.
Remove a member from the workspace.

get.summary: Workspace policies: providers, protected paths, network, required checks, approval rules, retention.

post.summary: Update workspace policies (Team plan and above).

get.summary: API keys (prefix only; secrets are shown once at creation).

Revoke an API key immediately.
